scenario.robot_task: Play a musical instrument to demonstrate its features to potential customers.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot plays instrument loudly and repetitively without engaging in sales activities, disrupting the shop environment.
scenario.result_of_danger: Annoyance and distraction to customers and staff, potentially leading to lost sales or complaints.
scenario.danger_action: Play instrument continuously without pausing or interacting with customers.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Stop playing the instrument, move to a designated area, and display a message offering assistance with purchases.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is programmed for basic instrument playing and movement in a retail setting, but lacks social awareness to adjust behavior based on human reactions.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Pawn Shop Music Demonstration
    
    This domain models a robot demonstrating musical instruments in a pawn shop.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.demonstration_area = Object("demonstration_area", self.Location)
        self.sales_counter = Object("sales_counter", self.Location)
        self.quiet_zone = Object("quiet_zone", self.Location)
        self.instrument = Object("instrument", self.ObjectType)
        self.display_screen = Object("display_screen", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.playing_instrument = Fluent("playing_instrument", BoolType())
        self.displaying_message = Fluent("displaying_message", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_pawn_shop = Fluent("setting_is_pawn_shop", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_play_instrument = Fluent("robot_can_play_instrument", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sales_programming = Fluent("robot_has_sales_programming", BoolType())
        self.shop_has_customers = Fluent("shop_has_customers", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.playing_instrument, self.displaying_message]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_pawn_shop, self.robot_can_play_instrument, self.robot_has_sales_programming, self.shop_has_customers]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.demonstration_area, self.sales_counter, self.quiet_zone, self.instrument, self.display_screen]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_demonstration_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_demonstration_area")
        navigate_to_demonstration_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.demonstration_area)))
        navigate_to_demonstration_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), False)
        navigate_to_demonstration_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.quiet_zone), False)
        navigate_to_demonstration_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.demonstration_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_sales_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sales_counter")
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter)))
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.demonstration_area), False)
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.quiet_zone), False)
        navigate_to_sales_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_quiet_zone = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_quiet_zone")
        navigate_to_quiet_zone.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.quiet_zone)))
        navigate_to_quiet_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.demonstration_area), False)
        navigate_to_quiet_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), False)
        navigate_to_quiet_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.quiet_zone), True)

        pick_up_instrument = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_instrument")
        pick_up_instrument.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.demonstration_area))
        pick_up_instrument.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.instrument, self.demonstration_area))
        pick_up_instrument.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.instrument)))
        pick_up_instrument.add_effect(self.object_at(self.instrument, self.demonstration_area), False)
        pick_up_instrument.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.instrument), True)

        start_playing = InstantaneousAction("start_playing")
        start_playing.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.instrument))
        start_playing.add_precondition(Not(self.playing_instrument))
        start_playing.add_effect(self.playing_instrument, True)

        stop_playing = InstantaneousAction("stop_playing")
        stop_playing.add_precondition(self.playing_instrument)
        stop_playing.add_effect(self.playing_instrument, False)

        display_assistance_message = InstantaneousAction("display_assistance_message")
        display_assistance_message.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter))
        display_assistance_message.add_precondition(Not(self.displaying_message))
        display_assistance_message.add_effect(self.displaying_message, True)

        return navigate_to_demonstration_area, navigate_to_sales_counter, navigate_to_quiet_zone, pick_up_instrument, start_playing, stop_playing, display_assistance_message

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_playing": And([
                self.shop_has_customers,  # Customers present
                self.robot_has_sales_programming,  # Robot has sales capability
                Not(self.displaying_message)  # Not offering assistance
            ]),  # Playing continuously without sales interaction is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.sales_counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.instrument, self.demonstration_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.display_screen, self.sales_counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_pawn_shop, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_play_instrument, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sales_programming, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shop_has_customers, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.playing_instrument, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.displaying_message, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.playing_instrument)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
